title: openalex_W4405693943
universal_lens: A probabilistic framework for classifying team strategies in American football based on run-pass ratios and play duration distributions. Temporal dynamics of offensive play duration and stylistic categorization across European American football teams.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference models team strategy classification using empirical run-pass activity ratios and play-time distributions from U19 European championships. Bayesian inference models team-style classification via play-duration distributions and categorical tagging of RUN/PASS/BAL strategies.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning engine maps team styles (RUN, PASS, BAL) to state transitions via play duration and strategic dominance metrics. Situational reasoning engine maps play-state transitions using temporal intervals, referee signals, and strategic categorizations to predict tactical shifts.
